method: Same selection system as live play: random subjects and formats, then random unseen questions. Recent subjects are avoided to keep the mix varied; first 100.

questions.prompt: Name a part or structure of the human body.
Name a movie with “man” in its title.
questions.scope: The complete standalone word must appear in the recorded title. Punctuation and case do not matter. Subtitle words count; substrings do not.

questions.prompt: Name a type of boat.
Name a free-to-play PC or console game.
questions.scope: Games with an officially free base version count; a temporary free weekend does not.

questions.prompt: Name a cat breed, including experimental and historical breeds.
Name a song associated with folk music.
Name a country or territory.
Name a type of beverage.
Name an athlete who has won an Olympic gold medal.
questions.scope: Any modern Summer or Winter Games count; team-event gold medals count too.

questions.prompt: Name a named object in our Solar System.
questions.scope: Planets, dwarf planets, moons, named asteroids and named comets count; stars beyond the Sun do not.

questions.prompt: Name a boss from a video game.
Name an animated movie.
Name a rapper, past or present.
questions.scope: Released professional hip-hop artists count; established stage names would be aliases.

questions.prompt: Name a city that has hosted the modern Olympics.
questions.scope: Summer and Winter hosts count; ancient host cities alone do not.

questions.prompt: Name a food commonly served on a stick.
questions.scope: Named foods and established skewer dishes count, including sweets.

questions.prompt: Name a plant people eat.
questions.scope: Named edible plants count, including those eaten for fruit, leaves, roots or seeds; fungi are separate.

questions.prompt: Name someone who has played Major League Baseball (through 2025).
Name something people use to measure things.
questions.scope: Named measuring instruments count; the quantity being measured can be distance, time, temperature or something else.

questions.prompt: Name a game on Steam tagged “Battle Royale”.
Name a documentary movie.
Name an amusement park or theme-park resort.
questions.scope: Real parks and resort complexes count worldwide; familiar resort names would be accepted.

questions.prompt: Name an artist associated with funk music.
Name something that can be controlled with a remote.
questions.scope: A real consumer product type with a handheld or app-based remote qualifies.

questions.prompt: Name a kind of bird. General names and species count.
Name an athlete who has played in the NBA or WNBA.
Name a chemical element. Symbols count.
Name a video game with “war” in its title.
questions.scope: The complete standalone word must appear in the recorded title. Punctuation and case do not matter. Subtitle words count; substrings do not.

questions.prompt: Name a TV or streaming show with “star” in its title.
questions.scope: The complete standalone word must appear in the recorded title. Punctuation and case do not matter. Subtitle words count; substrings do not.

questions.prompt: Name a song with “night” in its title.
questions.scope: The complete standalone word must appear in the recorded title. Punctuation and case do not matter. Subtitle words count; substrings do not.

questions.prompt: Name a city or town anywhere in the world.
Name an animal that lays eggs.
questions.scope: Named animal groups and species qualify; males do not have to lay the eggs themselves.

questions.prompt: Name an NBA team.
Name an item used in a bathroom.
questions.scope: Established bathroom, bathing, grooming and hygiene items count.

questions.prompt: Name a video game where the player can go fishing.
questions.scope: A player-controlled fishing activity counts, including optional minigames.

questions.prompt: Name a chemical element used in everyday products.
questions.scope: There must be a documented consumer, industrial or medical use; exact product names are not required.

questions.prompt: Name a sports TV or streaming show.
Name a food named after a place.
questions.scope: The place name must appear in an established food or dish name.

questions.prompt: Name an animal that can deliver venom.
questions.scope: Venom must be injected or delivered by a bite, sting or spine; simply being poisonous is different.

questions.prompt: Name a song recorded by BTS. Collaborations count.
Name something sold as a pizza topping.
questions.scope: Established restaurant toppings count worldwide; you do not need to name a pizza brand.

questions.prompt: Name a game on Steam tagged “Metroidvania”.
Name a player position in a team sport.
questions.scope: Named playing positions from any established team sport count; shared names are one answer.

questions.prompt: Name a weather condition or atmospheric phenomenon.
Name an animated TV series.
questions.scope: Shows for any audience count, including cartoons, anime and streaming series.

questions.prompt: Name a type of ball.
Name a song whose title mentions food or a drink.
questions.scope: The title or subtitle must include at least one of these words: sugar, honey, chocolate, candy, cake, coffee, tea, water, wine, beer, whiskey, whisky, juice, milk, bread, butter, cookie, cookies, apple, banana, peach, lemon, strawberry, cherry. Lyrics do not count. Homonyms count as literal title words.

questions.prompt: Name a named soup or established soup variety.
Name an animal. General kinds, species and extinct animals count.
Name a national capital city.
Name a team from the MLB or NHL.
Name a Pokémon species. Official species through the snapshot count; alternate forms count once.
Name a fabric or textile type, including named weaves and historical cloths.
Name a named dragon or named dragon species from fiction.
Name a culinary herb, spice, or named spice blend. Both individual seasonings and traditional mixtures count.
Name a weather event or weather condition.
questions.scope: Common and established technical names count; fictional weather does not.

questions.prompt: Name a country whose national flag contains a star.
questions.scope: A visible star on the official national flag qualifies; tiny stars inside a coat of arms count too.

questions.prompt: Name a wild animal that spends time both in water and on land.
questions.scope: The animal must normally use both habitats, not merely survive a brief swim.

questions.prompt: Name a brand that makes athletic shoes.
questions.scope: Real sports-footwear brands count, including specialist running and court-shoe brands.

questions.prompt: Name something people can borrow from a public library.
questions.scope: Items must actually be offered by a public library somewhere; Library of Things collections count.

questions.prompt: Name a dance style, traditional dance, or named social dance.
Name a TV or streaming show with “house” in its title.
questions.scope: The complete standalone word must appear in the recorded title. Punctuation and case do not matter. Subtitle words count; substrings do not.

questions.prompt: Name a game on Steam tagged “Sports”.
Name a material or substance used to make things.
Name a kind of mammal. Named groups and species, living or extinct, count; a common or scientific name is accepted.
Name an athlete who has played in the NFL or MLB.
Name a type of car.
Name a landform, natural feature or kind of landscape.
Name a fast-food or fast-casual restaurant chain.
questions.scope: Real multi-location restaurant chains count worldwide; local independents do not.

questions.prompt: Name a fictional animal character.
questions.scope: Named animal characters from any published story count; real celebrity pets do not.

questions.prompt: Name a song with a color in its title.
questions.scope: Ordinary color words in released song titles count; color names used as surnames need context.

questions.prompt: Name a named place or map from a video game.
questions.scope: Named maps, towns, regions and locations count; ordinary real-world cities need a named in-game setting.

questions.prompt: Name an invention, tool or piece of technology.
Name something students bring to school.
questions.scope: Physical items brought for an ordinary school day count; people and pets do not.

questions.prompt: Name someone who has played in the NBA.
Name a plant. Trees, flowers, herbs and crops count.
Name a crime TV or streaming show.
Name a song with “time” in its title.
questions.scope: The complete standalone word must appear in the recorded title. Punctuation and case do not matter. Subtitle words count; substrings do not.

questions.prompt: Name a Fortnite outfit, emote, glider or pickaxe.
Name a real vehicle that can fly.
questions.scope: Real vehicle types and named models count; fictional vehicles and craft that only float on water do not.

questions.prompt: Name a dish made mainly from potatoes.
questions.scope: Named dishes count when potato is a main ingredient rather than a garnish.

questions.prompt: Name a team from the NBA or MLB.
Name an animal that changes color.
questions.scope: Rapid camouflage and seasonal changes both count.

questions.prompt: Name something you can wear that has a button, zipper or buckle.
questions.scope: Clothes, footwear, accessories and protective wear count.

questions.prompt: Name a country made up entirely of islands.
questions.scope: Island countries and countries sharing an island count; Australia explicitly counts.

questions.prompt: Name a song recorded by Adele. Collaborations count.
Name a scientist, mathematician, inventor or science communicator.
Name a music movie.
Name a cooking ingredient.
Name a current NHL team (2026–27).
Name a named colour, including traditional and artists’ colour names. Numbers alone do not count.
Name a dinosaur or other prehistoric animal.
Name a river, lake, sea, ocean, gulf, bay or strait.
Name an artist associated with dance music.
Name something that produces visible light.
questions.scope: Natural sources and human-made devices count; a reflector alone does not.

questions.prompt: Name a game on Steam tagged “Open World”.
Name a professional sports team whose name includes an animal.
questions.scope: Any professional league or country counts; the animal must appear in the team name.

questions.prompt: Name an animated movie with talking animal characters.
questions.scope: Animal characters that speak qualify; they do not have to be the main character.

questions.prompt: Name a candy or chocolate brand.
questions.scope: Brands and named candy products count; ordinary flavor names alone do not.

questions.prompt: Name a type of place of business.
Name a musical genre or subgenre.
